metadata.title: The flipping principle for boundedly acyclic covers and colorings
metadata.abstract: Based on the theory of multicomplexes and other ideas by Gromov, we describe the flipping principle. This is an easy geometric criterion that forces the vanishing of the Gromov norm of homology classes. We use it to provide proofs based on a common geometric principle of the Vanishing Theorem and the Amenable Reduction Lemma by Gromov in the case of amenable and boundedly acyclic covers and colorings. We also strengthen the conclusion of the Amenable Reduction Lemma by showing that it implies the $\ell^1$-invisibility of the homology classes and not only the vanishing of their Gromov norm.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 有界上同调与几何消灭原理
analysis.workSummary: 利用多重复形及 Gromov 的相关思想，作者提出使同调类 Gromov 范数消失的几何“翻转原理”，并用同一机制统一证明涉及可和或有界无环覆盖与着色的消灭定理和可和约化引理。进一步把可和约化引理的结论加强为同调类的 ℓ¹ 不可见性。
techniques: 覆盖与着色的翻转构造
ℓ¹ 同调与 Gromov 半范数
analysis.breakthrough: 将既有消灭结果置于共同几何机制下，且 ℓ¹ 不可见性比仅有 Gromov 范数为零提供更强的同调信息。
analysis.limitations: 应用依赖覆盖或着色满足相应可和性、有界无环性及定理中的组合条件；不能推广成任意覆盖下的范数消失。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: AI disclosure 明确说所有思想、论证、结果与证明均不使用 AI，而 ChatGPT Astra 与 Claude Opus 5 用于 proofreading；因此记为写作校对，不标记证明、核心思想或数学核验。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.35222v1 · PDF 第 5 页 AI disclosure

analysis.priorityReason: 对单纯体体积、有界上同调和几何拓扑有基础意义，可作为几何分析主线之外的次优先阅读。
